title: 第七章 我也喜欢第八章 好一击回旋踢
lines: “这个，我可以参与，但打不好你们别怪我。”小白率先说道，“既然大家都这么喜欢，说不定我也会喜欢。”
司马仪一把搂住小白，“小白，你最好了，我就知道你是我们学校最帅最善良的，我要是女人一定嫁给你！”
“你们都这样，我能说什么，一寝室四兄弟，要死一块死！”范建国耸耸肩说道。
“剩下那个人交给我，我们学校有个一区钻石大神叫柳青，是我好朋友，一拖四也没问题，嘿嘿，这次给周旭阳一个惊喜！”
司马仪是人来疯，忽然觉得信心十足，输给周旭阳一直是他的心结，有的时候还被小薰拿来对比，别的比不上，他还真不信lol也比不过，他甚至怀疑周旭阳连键盘都不知道怎么按。
几个人本来就是游戏爱好者，一开始往后缩的时候人人都往后缩。但是真说起来之后，倒是越说越起劲儿了，当然没人把李牧说的当回事，只当他是给大家鼓劲，山东人嘛，不怂的。
真要下了决定，范建和司马仪两个瞬间唾沫横飞，把嘴强王者的风范发挥得那是一个淋漓尽致！
就在两人正唾沫横飞说得起劲的时候，小白的电话突然叫了两声。小白拿出电话，低头扫了一眼。
旁边的范建国眼尖，也跟着看了过去。
小白的手机屏幕上显示出来的是一条短信。
“小白哥，我已经出地铁站了，很快就到学校门口。”
短信发送人的姓名，在白启的手机上也是存好的，叫“悠悠”。
“呦！小白哥哟，悠悠？”司马仪立刻露出一个所有男人都明白的笑容来，“我就说嘛，以你的资质要么藏了女朋友，要么就是喜欢男人！”
经过三年的洗练，小白等人对于司马喷子已经免疫了。
“这个真的不是，就是我说的那个邻居到了，不过也很多年没见了。”
“啊？邻居？”范建一脸的不信，“真的来了？”
“她小时候全家移民的，这次是来沪政留学的，国内也没什么朋友，我们两家偶尔还有联系，所以……”
“呦呵？还是外国友人？”小白最后那句话顿时就带歪了楼。几个人的注意力全都从两个人的关系，转到外国友人这件事上去了。
“美国长大的姑娘啊，肯定热情奔放，行，这妹妹就交给我了，你们放心好了！”司马仪的嘴又开始浪了。
“行了行了！哥几个还在这儿说什么呢？人家美国友人要来咱们沪政留学，赶紧行动起来！去迎接一下啊！”李牧右手用力一挥，四狼顿时全体出动，奔着学校大门口就去了。
从宿舍到校门口走了差不多十来分钟，开学季肯定是热闹，四人也不着急，目光四处逡巡，悠悠从地铁站过来也需要点时间，司马仪还兼职帮小学妹指路，浪的绝对。
“对了，有照片吗，让大家看看，不然一会儿怎么找？”司马仪忽然想起了，这才是重点啊。
小白拿出手机，“有一张。”
上面的姑娘身材高挑，长的很不错，就是穿着美式学校的校服，就是表情有点严肃。
“不错，看这样子，85分以上。”老司机的司马仪说道。
content_en:
"I can participate in this, but don't blame me if you don't win well." Xiaobai took the lead and said, "Since everyone likes it so much, maybe I will like it too."
Sima Yi hugged Xiaobai and said, "Xiaobai, you are the best. I knew you were the most handsome and kind-hearted in our school. If I were a woman, I would definitely marry you!"
"You are all like this. What can I say? Four brothers in one dormitory will die together!" Fan Jianguo shrugged.
"Leave the remaining person to me. There is a diamond master in District 1 in our school named Liu Qing. He is a good friend of mine. He can drag four of them with him. Hehe, give Zhou Xuyang a surprise this time!"
Sima Yi is crazy and suddenly feels confident. Losing to Zhou Xuyang has always been a knot in his mind. Sometimes, Xiaoxun compares him to others. He really doesn't believe that lol can't compare to him. He even suspects that Zhou Xuyang doesn't even know how to press the keyboard.
Several people were already game enthusiasts, and when they started to move back, everyone moved back. But after he actually talked about it, he became more and more enthusiastic about it. Of course, no one took what Li Mu said seriously, they just thought that he was trying to encourage everyone. Shandong people are not timid.
When they really had to make a decision, Fan Jian and Sima Yi were instantly salivating, displaying their strong-mouthed kingly demeanor to the fullest!
Just when the two of them were talking excitedly, Xiaobai's phone suddenly rang twice. Xiaobai took out the phone and glanced down.
Fan Jianguo next to him also looked over with sharp eyes.
What was displayed on the screen of Xiaobai's mobile phone was a text message.
"Brother Bai, I have already left the subway station and will be at the school gate soon."
The name of the sender of the text message was also saved on Bai Qi's mobile phone, and it was called "Yuyou".
"Yo! Brother Xiaobai, Yoyo?" Sima Yi immediately showed a smile that all men could understand, "Let me just say, with your qualifications, you either hide your girlfriend or you like men!"
After three years of training, Xiaobai and others have become immune to Sima's trolls.
"This is really not the case. It's just that the neighbor I mentioned has arrived, but I haven't seen him for many years."
"Ah? Neighbor?" Fan Jian looked unbelieving, "Really here?"
"Her family immigrated when she was young. This time she came to Shanghai to study abroad. She doesn't have many friends in China. Our two families occasionally have contact, so..."
"Huh? Or a foreign friend?" Xiaobai's last words immediately caused confusion. The attention of several people turned from the relationship between the two people to the matter of foreign friends.
"A girl who grew up in the United States must be passionate and unrestrained. Okay, I'll leave this sister to me. Don't worry!" Sima Yi started to talk nonsense again.
"Okay, okay! What are you guys talking about here? My American friends are coming to our school to study in Huzheng. Act quickly! Go and greet them!" Li Mu waved his right hand vigorously, and the four wolves immediately mobilized and rushed to the school gate.
It took about ten minutes to walk from the dormitory to the school gate. It was definitely a busy school season. The four of them were not in a hurry, and their eyes were wandering around. It would take some time for Youyou to get from the subway station. Sima Yi also worked part-time to help the elementary school girl guide the way. It was definitely a waste of time.
"By the way, are there any photos? Let everyone take a look. Otherwise, how will you find them later?" Sima Yi suddenly remembered that this is the key point.
Xiaobai took out his mobile phone and said, "There is one."
The girl above is tall and good-looking. She is wearing an American school uniform, but her expression is a bit serious.
"Not bad. Look at it, it's over 85 points." Sima Yi, an experienced driver, said.
